messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-9842 — inference latency spike — region: eu-west-1 — affected route: /v1/generate :rotating_light:
pagerbot: auto-ack attempted — no responder claimed within 30s, escalating to on-call layer 2 :arrow_up:
maria.gonzalez: seeing a few 500s and high p95 on the latency dashboard, nice catch. pulling logs now. @diego are you on shift?
diego: on call, claiming. acked PD-INC-9842. taking ownership. will triage. :handshake:
ashwin: thanks @diego — quick note: customer-facing A (acct-042) is showing elevated error rates per pagerduty payload. could be noisy cache evictions.
diego: got it. first check: k/v cache eviction rate + autoscaler events. running: `kubectl logs -n inference svc-router-2 | grep eviction`
ashwin: copying metrics: autoscaler bumped pool from 6 -> 10 around 12:03:45 UTC, then several OOMs on gpu-node-17.
maria.gonzalez: can you confirm whether fallback routing to smaller model variants kicked in? console shows a handful of fallback events 12:04:10-12:06:00 UTC.
diego: yep, fallback to model: rwd-llama-7b-quant reduced throughput and increased latencies. rolling a canary to reduce memory pressure.
incidentbot: Note: PD escalation timer 10m remaining before region-wide notify.
ashwin: customer-impact summary for now: intermittent 5xx for a small percentage (~0.8%) of requests for 2 premium customers. No SLA breach yet but trending.
maria.gonzalez: mitigating step 1: scale down batch_size on router to prioritize latency: `settings.batch_size: 8` applied to route /v1/generate in eu-west-1.
diego: applying CPU/GPU drain on gpu-node-17 to force pods off the problematic host. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets`
ashwin: alerting support for acct-042 with brief PSA: we’re investigating (latency spike) — ETA 15-30m.
diego: after drain, p95 latencies dropped by ~40% on the affected route. error rate trending down. continuing to monitor.
maria.gonzalez: can we avoid autoscaler thrash? looks like scale-to-zero misfire triggered a ripple. suggest adding a cooldown 60s for this pool.
ashwin: agreed. filing a follow-up infra ticket. moving to postmortem if stabilized.
incidentbot: PD note: ownership: @diego (current responder). next steps: verify node health, confirm customer update, and coordinate rollback of temporary batching in 30m if stable.
diego: will keep the bridge updated. ping me directly for any customer escalations. :thumbsup:
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook checklist triggered: (1) Claim acked? yes. (2) Mitigation applied? yes (batch_size and drain). (3) Customer notified? yes. (4) Follow-up ticket created? in progress.
maria.gonzalez: final status check in 20m to confirm full resolution before closing PD.
incidentbot: thread locked to oncall until resolved. PD-INC-9842 status: acknowledged, mitigation in progress.
